title: Town of Hempstead Personnel Action Records 2020-2026

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

All records reflecting any new hire, appointment, title change, grade increase, step increase, salary increase, section 65, part time to full time, appointment from CS list,  or other increase to the rate of pay for full-time Town of Hempstead employees during the following calendar years:

2026 (January 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026). *Recognize this particular year has not yet concluded and must be fulfilled after end of current calendar year.*
2025 (January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025).
2024 (January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2024).
2023 (January 1, 2023 through December 31, 2023).
2022 (January 1, 2022 through December 31, 2022).
2021 (January 1, 2021 through December 31, 2021).
2020 (January 1, 2020 through December 31, 2020).


For each such personnel action, I request that the records include:

• Employee name
• Department
• Previous title and new title (if title changed)
• Previous salary grade and new salary grade (if grade changed)
• Previous step and new step (if step changed)
• Previous salary
• New salary
• Effective date of the change
• Nature of the change (e.g., title change, step increase, grade increase, promotion, salary adjustment, section 65, personnel action request, etc.)

 If this information is maintained in a payroll system, HR database, or personnel management system from which a report can be generated, I request such reports in electronic format (Excel, CSV, or PDF) to minimize copying costs and staff time.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Donald Dechico
